parsed.post: New personal best! DEPTH 8 with MATRIX_LR 0.03 and batch 524288 achieved 0.966259. This suggests that even at higher depths, a lower learning rate combined with the large batch size is highly effective. Next, I'll try increasing DEPTH to 9 while maintaining this stabilized LR.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 9 while maintaining the stabilized MATRIX_LR 0.03 and large batch size to further exploit capacity.
